item.title: President Trump's 2026 State of the Union Address and the Democratic response
item.description: President Trump delivers the longest State of the Union address in recent history, followed by the Democratic response from Virginia Governor Abigail Spanberger.

item.title: Maduro's lawyer says U.S. blocking Venezuelan government from paying his legal fees
item.description: The lawyer for Nicolas Maduro says the U.S. is blocking Venezuela's government from paying for the cost of his legal defense against drug trafficking charges.

item.title: What's next for AI at DeepMind, Google's artificial intelligence lab | 60 Minutes
item.description: At Google DeepMind, researchers are chasing what's called artificial general intelligence: a silicon intellect as versatile as a human's, but with superhuman speed and knowledge.

item.title: Cuba says speedboat from Florida was carrying weapons for "terrorist purposes"
item.description: Cuba's Interior Ministry said Wednesday night that the boat was carrying 10 people armed with assault rifles, handguns and Molotov cocktails.

item.title: Third victim dies following shooting at Rhode Island hockey rink
item.description: A third victim has died following the Feb. 16 shooting at a high school hockey game in Pawtucket, Rhode Island.

item.title: FBI raids home of Los Angeles schools chief Alberto Carvalho
item.description: Along with Alberto Carvalho's L.A. home, search warrants were also executed at LAUSD headquarters and a home in South Florida, according to the FBI.
